findings.governingReading: Rider speaks in an even, dispassionate manner, and Shirou finds himself entranced by it.
findings.explanation: The English turns manner of delivery into an unsupported claim that Rider lacks interest.

findings.evidenceJa: それがおかしかったのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether his flustered request struck Rider as amusing.
findings.explanation: “Must have” promotes his open interpretation of her reaction into certainty.

findings.highlight: You must be a good person. I understand why Shinji is trying to have you on his side.
findings.evidenceJa: 人が好いのですね、貴方は。シンジが懐柔しようというのも解ります
findings.governingReading: Rider observes that Shirou is guilelessly good-natured, making Shinji’s attempt to coax or win him over understandable.
findings.explanation: The English turns a warning about exploitable good nature into praise and softens 懐柔 into ordinary team recruitment.
